data.title: Hong Kong stocks hit 4-month low, as US-China tensions weigh on tech
data.description:
Hong Kong's share benchmark sank 2% to hit four-month lows while China stocks remained under pressure, as fresh trade tensions flared up between the US and China despite meetings between Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Shenzhen.

** Risk appetite was also pressured by the prospect of further US rate hikes that could tighten global liquidity.

** Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dropped 2%, plumbing to its lowest level since late June. The Hang Seng Tech Index hit a 26-month low as it extended its losing streak to seven sessions.

** In China, the blue-chip CSI300 Index finished flat and the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.3%, hitting the lowest in more than 15 months.

** Xi said on Thursday he remained committed to working with Trump to steer ties between their countries on the "correct course", even as China's commerce ministry voiced strong opposition to a recent series of economic and trade restrictions the US imposed against China.

** The Nvidia saga has led to tighter scrutiny of US chip exports to China.

** The Trump administration is also considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models to discourage reliance on the technology.

** Meanwhile, a US House panel asked Microsoft on Wednesday to brief lawmakers on a report that said the company could allow the Chinese firm ByteDance to use OpenAI models through Microsoft's Azure cloud platform.

** These developments deepened investor worry that the world's two largest economies are careening toward a fresh tit-for-tat trade war, after the Republicans' defeat in the US midterms appears to have prompted the White House to take a more hawkish policy toward China.

** Hong Kong-listed AI model developers and AI hyperscalers, whose competitiveness depends on advanced computing power, tumbled on Thursday.

** MiniMax slumped as much as 11% to record lows while Z.AI lost 2%.

** Tencent tumbled nearly 7% to a 31-month low after its third-quarter revenue missed forecasts, and the company said new US chip curbs may slow model training.

** Alibaba tanked 5.5% to a 22-month low, while Shanghai Iluvatar CoreX Semiconductor slumped 17%.

** In China, tech stocks that rely on advanced chips, including cloud computing (.CSI931469), AI and big data , led the declines.

data.title: LT Foods acquires Maya Kaimal for $5.8 million to deepen U.S. presence
data.description:
LT Foods Limited announced on November 19, 2026, that its U.S. subsidiary, LT Foods Americas Inc., has signed an agreement to acquire 100 per cent stake in MK Foods Holdings Inc., the parent company of Maya Kaimal Foods LLC, for an enterprise value of USD 5.8 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis. The deal is expected to close within three months, subject to standard closing conditions.

Maya Kaimal Foods offers a portfolio of premium Indian-inspired shelf-stable sauces, ready-to-eat curries and rice products. The brand reported revenue of USD 17.9 million for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, up from USD 15.5 million in the prior year — a growth of roughly 15.5 per cent.

Acquisition to expand US ready-to-eat portfolio

The acquisition is aimed at expanding LT Foods’ Ready-to-Eat, Ready-to-Cook and Ready-to-Heat portfolio in the United States, which the company has identified as a strategically important growth market. The company said Maya Kaimal’s product development capabilities in sauces and convenient meal solutions are complementary to its existing business, and the deal is expected to open new distribution and cross-category growth opportunities.

Managing Director and CEO Ashwani Arora said the combined businesses would leverage LT Foods’ scale and market reach alongside Maya Kaimal’s consumer brand and innovation capabilities to build a sustainable growth platform in the U.S. market.

Ernst & Young served as the exclusive transaction advisor for LT Foods on the deal.

LT Foods’ financials and stock performance

LT Foods, listed on both the NSE and BSE, reported consolidated revenue of approximately ₹11,023 crore for FY26. The company’s existing U.S. portfolio is anchored by Royal, one of North America’s leading rice brands. Its stock traded at ₹439.85 on the NSE on the day of the announcement, up 4.91 per cent from the previous close of ₹419.25, touching an intraday high of ₹461.35. The stock has delivered returns of over 547 per cent over the past five years against the Nifty 500’s 55.39 per cent over the same period.

data.title: Aurionpro wins ₹100 crore data centre order, crosses ₹400 crore mark with Hyperscaler
data.description:
Aurionpro Solutions has secured an additional order worth nearly ₹100 crore from a global hyperscaler for an AI-ready data centre project in Southern India, the company announced on November 19, 2026.

The latest contract pushes the total value of engagements with this customer past ₹400 crore.

The project is scheduled for execution over nine months and represents an expansion of an existing engagement with the same hyperscaler announced earlier this year.

Bhaskar Bhattacharya, EVP and Head of Enterprise Business at Aurionpro, said the company is investing in advanced manufacturing as part of a backward integration strategy to gain greater supply chain control and improve operational efficiency for hyperscale clients.

Aurionpro shares were trading at ₹556.25 on the NSE at the time of the announcement, up marginally by 0.07 per cent.

The stock has had a difficult year, down over 47 per cent year-to-date and approximately 51 per cent over the past twelve months, against a broadly flat Nifty Total Market.

The company’s total market capitalisation stands at around ₹3,074 crore.

Aurionpro Solutions operates across banking, payments, mobility, data centres, and government sectors. The company employs over 3,000 people globally.

The growing data centre order book is emerging as a key area of traction even as the broader stock has faced significant selling pressure over the past year.

data.title: Kuaishou Technology Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description:
HONG KONG, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kuaishou Technology ("Kuaishou" or the "Company"; HKD Counter Stock Code: 01024 / RMB Counter Stock Code: 81024), a leading content community and social platform, today announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Third Quarter 2026 Key Highlights

  • Average DAUs on Kuaishou APP were 417.3 million, representing an increase of 0.3% from 416.2 million for the same period of 2025.
  • Average MAUs on Kuaishou APP were 818.5 million, representing an increase of 12.0% from 731.1 million for the same period of 2025.
  • Total revenue was RMB31.6 billion, compared to RMB35.6 billion for the same period of 2025. Online marketing services and live streaming contributed 56.6% and 24.5%, respectively, to the total revenue. The other 18.9% came from other services.
  • Gross profit was RMB15.2 billion, compared to RMB19.4 billion for the same period of 2025. Gross profit margin in the third quarter of 2026 was 48.2%, compared to 54.7% for the same period of 2025.
  • Loss for the period was RMB959 million, compared to a profit of RMB4.5 billion for the same period of 2025. Adjusted net profit(1) was RMB790 million, compared to RMB5.0 billion for the same period of 2025.
  • Operating profit from the domestic segment(2) was RMB420 million, compared to RMB5.4 billion for the same period of 2025. Operating loss from the overseas segment(2) was RMB23 million, compared to RMB64 million for the same period of 2025.
  • During the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company repurchased 39,132,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for a consideration of approximately HKD1.41 billion.

Mr. Cheng Yixiao, Co-founder, Chairman, and Chief Executive Officer of Kuaishou, commented, "In the third quarter of 2026, amid a complex and evolving external environment and facing short-term pressure on our business, we stayed committed to our long-term vision. We firmly invested in AI, maintained prudent financial discipline to improve operational quality and efficiency, and continued to strengthen the foundations of our businesses. During the third quarter of 2026, average DAUs on the Kuaishou App reached 417 million. Total revenues were RMB31.6 billion, adjusted net profit was RMB790 million and adjusted EBITDA(3) was RMB3.9 billion. On the AI innovation front, we unveiled Kling 4.0, our next-generation video generation model, enhanced our professional film and television production capabilities, and expanded our global creator ecosystem. These advances further consolidated Kling AI's global leadership in multimodal large video generation models. Meanwhile, we deepened the application of AI across content recommendation, online marketing, e-commerce operations and organizational infrastructure, enhancing user experience and merchants' operating efficiency. We continued to deliver on our commitment to shareholder returns. For the first three quarters of 2026, total shareholder returns, including dividends and share repurchases, amounted to over HK$5.8 billion. Looking ahead, we will focus on strengthening our community ecosystem, while continuing to drive AI technology and product innovation, striving to maintain a balance between shareholder returns and the cash reserves needed to support the Company's long-term development."

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Review

Revenue from our online marketing services decreased by 11.1% to RMB17.9 billion for the third quarter of 2026, from RMB20.1 billion for the same period of 2025, primarily attributable to the decline in e-commerce marketing spending due to the dynamic consumer environment and intensifying competition across the e-commerce sector.

Revenue from our live streaming business decreased by 19.0% to RMB7.8 billion for the third quarter of 2026, from RMB9.6 billion for the same period of 2025, as a result of our continuous efforts to develop a rich and healthy live streaming ecosystem.

Revenue from our other services increased by 1.5% to RMB6.0 billion for the third quarter of 2026, from RMB5.9 billion for the same period of 2025, primarily attributable to the increase in games and Kling AI revenue, partially offset by the decrease in e-commerce revenue.

Other Key Financial Information for the Third Quarter of 2026

Operating loss was RMB635 million, compared to operating profit of RMB5.3 billion for the same period of 2025.

Adjusted EBITDA was RMB3.9 billion, compared to RMB7.7 billion for the same period of 2025.

Total available funds(4) reached RMB127.2 billion as of September 30, 2026.

Notes:

(1) We define "adjusted net profit" as (loss)/profit for the period adjusted by share-based compensation expenses, net fair value changes on investments and finance costs on redemption financial liabilities.

(2) Unallocated items, which consist of share-based compensation expenses, other income, and other gains, net, are not included.

(3) We define "adjusted EBITDA" as (loss)/profit for the period adjusted by share-based compensation expenses, net fair value changes on investments, income tax expenses, depreciation of property and equipment, depreciation of right-of-use assets, amortization of intangible assets and finance expenses, net.

(4) Total available funds which we considered in cash management included but not limited to cash and cash equivalents, time deposits, financial assets and restricted cash. Financial assets mainly included wealth management products and others.

Business Review

In the third quarter of 2026, the average DAUs on the Kuaishou App reached 417.3 million, representing a slight year-over-year increase. Due to market competition, the average daily time spent per DAU on the Kuaishou App in the same quarter declined year-over-year. In the third quarter of 2026, total revenues were RMB31.6 billion, adjusted net profit was RMB790 million and adjusted EBITDA was RMB3.9 billion, each of which experienced a year-over-year decrease.

Dynamic consumer environment and intensifying external competition exerted short-term pressure on our business during the period. Despite increased investment in our AI strategy this year, particularly in Kling AI (可靈AI), we maintained prudent financial discipline to improve operational quality and efficiency. We also continued to honor our commitment to shareholder returns. In the third quarter of 2026, the Company repurchased a total of over 39 million shares for an aggregate consideration of over HK$1.4 billion. In the first three quarters of 2026, total shareholder returns, including dividends(1) and share repurchases, amounted to over HK$5.8 billion, reflecting Kuaishou's long-term confidence in its business and its endeavor to return value to the Shareholders.

AI business

In the third quarter of 2026, Kling AI continued to pursue its vision of "empowering everyone to craft captivating stories with AI". Through technological breakthroughs in its next-generation video generation models, enhanced professional filmmaking capabilities and the continued expansion of its global creator ecosystem, Kling AI further strengthened its global leadership among multimodal large video generation models. These advancements supported the evolution of AI video generation towards higher-quality outputs, greater controllability, and increasingly sophisticated professional creative applications.

At the model and product level, Kling AI announced its next-generation video generation model, Kling 4.0, in September 2026 and began rolling out Kling 4.0 Flash to a limited set of users. The new model delivers comprehensive upgrades in audiovisual performance, creative control and narrative completeness, with enhanced stability in complex dynamic motion and camera movements. It supports native video generation of up to 30 seconds, multi-keyframe control and multimodal reference inputs, thereby significantly enhancing the expressiveness and controllability of professional content creation. Meanwhile, Kling AI continued to refine its integrated creative platform, upgrading features including high-precision video editing, timeline-based creation and agent-assisted creation to further improve the efficiency of professional content creation.

In professional filmmaking and global creative ecosystem development, Kling AI continued to strengthen its partnerships with professional film and television production teams and creators worldwide, extending the use of AI video generation into professional film and television production pipelines. In the third quarter of 2026, Kling AI participated in the inaugural edition of TIFF: The Market, a marketplace officially launched by the Toronto International Film Festival, showcasing practical applications of AI in feature-length animation, film and television previsualization and hybrid production. One such example is the international animated feature MINIBOTS, which integrated Kling AI into its professional production workflow, exploring the application of generative AI in cinema-grade 4K animation production. In July 2026, Kling AI also hosted the Kling AI NEXTGEN Awards Ceremony in Seoul, South Korea. The competition attracted more than 10,000 submissions, further expanding Kling AI's presence and influence within the global professional filmmaking community.

In the third quarter of 2026, beyond Kling AI, we continued to deepen AI applications across our content ecosystem, commercial ecosystem and organizational infrastructure. We advanced the application of GoalRank, our next-generation, large-scale generative re-ranking architecture, in short-video recommendation scenarios. GoalRank is designed to optimize the overall user viewing experience across multiple short videos. Through model engineering optimizations, it increases user time spent on short-video content without requiring additional inference computing resources. In the third quarter of 2026, AI adoption across online marketing services and e-commerce business shifted from single-model efficiency gains to large-scale, system-level deployment. Generative recommendation, AIGC, smart bidding, and recommendation-model agents now work together, reshaping commercial content production, the marketing materials replacement, and the way of algorithms iterations. In the third quarter of 2026, we rolled out AI-native ways of working across the Group organization and launched MyFlicker 2.0. MyFlicker 2.0 consolidated AI assets such as team skills and knowledge, building team-level agents. At the end of September 2026, we established an enterprise AI productivity organization, iWork (企業AI生產力), that coordinates and integrates general-purpose agents, including MyFlicker, enterprise information systems and enterprise context. This initiative advances our AI-empowered organizational transformation across the Group. Meanwhile, Kuaishou Vanchin (快手萬擎), our one-stop AI infrastructure platform, optimized its model inference engine. The platform empowers internal and external clients with more efficient end-to-end services for model customization, deployment and inference. These capabilities have supported rapid revenue growth of Kuaishou Vanchin. In the third quarter of 2026, revenue from Kuaishou Vanchin increased by nearly 90.0% quarter-over-quarter.

User and content ecosystem

In the third quarter of 2026, average DAUs on the Kuaishou App reached 417.3 million, and average MAUs reached 818.5 million, representing year-over-year growth of 0.3% and 12.0%, respectively. We continued to cultivate our content community with distinctive Kuaishou characteristics, while reinforcing the community core that is inclusive, trustworthy, and diverse. We iterated on our user retention mechanisms and leveraged refined operations to strengthen users' content consumption mindset, thereby enhancing user retention and stickiness. We also optimized the private messaging experience, introduced more social interaction features, and strengthened users' mutual connections. The average daily number of users with mutual followers engaging in private messaging increased by more than 7.0% year-over-year in the third quarter of 2026. Among them, the average daily number of users interacting through the social pet-raising feature Huozaizai (火崽崽) exceeded 46 million.

In the third quarter of 2026, we continued to enrich our high-quality content, with a focus on strengthening Kuaishou's distinctive community. We provided users with differentiated and heartwarming content. We once again partnered with Beijing Radio and Television Station (北京衛視) to present the 2026 Kuaishou Super Summer Gala (2026快手超級夏晚), staying true to Kuaishou's unique community culture. Featuring celebrities performing alongside Kuaishou creators, the gala offered users a summer party full of everyday warmth. The gala's livestream attracted more than 200 million cumulative views. In the third quarter of 2026, in sports content, we capitalized on the Asian Games, bringing together renowned athletes and everyday Kuaishou creators to develop a series of diverse sports IPs with distinctive Kuaishou characteristics, including the X.Y. Style Harvest Sports Meet (象牙山豐收運動會), Table Tennis Dream Showdown (乒乓夢之戰) and Kuaishou 100-Meter Dash (快手百米大戰). Together, these initiatives generated more than 19.5 billion cumulative short-video views.

Moreover, Lord of the Mysteries (詭秘之主), an MMORPG developed by our in-house gaming brand, SPARK NEXA (彈指宇宙), was launched in the third quarter of 2026. Adapted from the highly acclaimed online novel IP of the same name, the game was built using Unreal Engine 5. In the first hour following its launch, the game attracted more than 1 million users, with peak concurrent users reaching 700,000. It topped the free games chart of the Mainland China's App Store for a number of consecutive days. The game also delivered strong paying user conversion, marking a breakthrough in our in-house development capabilities in hardcore games.

Online marketing services

In the third quarter of 2026, revenue from online marketing services was RMB17.9 billion, representing a decrease of 11.1% year-over-year. Supported by year-over-year growth in marketing budgets in the content consumption sector, particularly in the AI-generated short plays vertical, our non-e-commerce marketing services revenue outperformed our overall revenue from online marketing services. Amid intensifying competition across the e-commerce sector, our e-commerce marketing services focused on improving merchant ROI by enhancing the synergy between our e-commerce and online marketing businesses, and through more granular merchant segmentation.

In the third quarter of 2026, within our non-e-commerce marketing services business, the content consumption sector performed strongly, and the lifestyle services sector remained solid. In the content consumption sector, we continued to expand the supply of AI-generated and live-action short plays with distinctive Kuaishou characteristics, driving sustained growth in high-quality short-play content. As of September 2026, the average daily number of active short plays increased by more than 350.0% compared with January 2026, further demonstrating the value of short plays within our content ecosystem. Underpinned by an abundant supply of short plays and rising user demand for such content, total spending on online marketing services in the content consumption sector increased by more than 100.0% year-over-year in the third quarter of 2026. In the lifestyle services sector, we continued to advance industry-specific refined operations, thereby capturing incremental growth opportunities in sub-verticals such as comprehensive services and local services. Meanwhile, across sectors including home renovation, travel and automotive, we cultivated high-quality vertical content to help our clients more effectively guide users from initial interest generation to marketing conversion, fostering a healthier and more sustainable marketing ecosystem.

In the third quarter of 2026, for e-commerce marketing services, we continued to enhance synergies and efficiencies between our e-commerce and online marketing businesses. Amid dynamic consumer environment and intensifying competition across the e-commerce sector, we realigned our organization around merchant segmentation, allocating more resources to merchant services and strengthening customer support. These initiatives began to yield initial results during the third quarter of 2026. Meanwhile, our operational initiatives helped boost merchant engagement, driving quarter-over-quarter improvements in merchants' marketing spend in the lifestyle consumption and daily necessities categories. During the third quarter of 2026, we continuously optimize our business ecosystem. We directed more traffic towards high-quality content and introduced a post-purchase traffic coordination strategy to reduce repetitive exposure to similar products after transactions. These measures improved marketing clients' ROI while safeguarding user experiences. In the third quarter of 2026, brand merchants' marketing spend continued to increase, supported by initiatives including supports for new branded stores in their early growth stage, targeted user management and long-term signal modeling for product recommendations. At the product level of e-commerce marketing services, our Net Transaction ROI (淨成交ROI) product continued to evolve. Through improvements to bidding adjustments, the introduction of mid-campaign switching capabilities, client incentive programs and refinements to the model's order cancellation and return features, the product's penetration rate in e-commerce marketing spending increased from 28.0% in the second quarter of 2026 to 34.7% in the third quarter of 2026. These enhancements further improved the certainty of transaction outcomes that e-commerce merchants derive from marketing placements.

In the third quarter of 2026, we continued to enhance the applications of AI across our online marketing services. Our Universal Auto X (UAX, 全自動投放) placement solutions evolved from a single-point strategy into a multi-agent collaborative framework. The upgraded framework automatically diagnoses marketing placement performance issues within accounts and coordinates multiple placement capabilities to improve clients' marketing placement efficiency. We also enhanced our AIGC marketing materials solutions by incorporating user interest signals. When the existing library of marketing materials does not sufficiently cover user interests, our product will generate additional marketing materials better tailored to target audiences, thereby further improving the matching efficiency between marketing materials and user needs.

E-commerce

In the third quarter of 2026, our e-commerce business faced pressure from dynamic consumer environment and intensifying competition across the e-commerce sector, coupled with rising operating costs for merchants. We optimized our organizational structure around more granular merchant segmentation with more targeted merchant policies and resource allocation to support merchants in building sustainable businesses on our platform. During the third quarter of 2026, on the demand side, we focused on building a high-quality paying user base by improving how we identify and serve such users. We increased their engagement by broadening the range of product offerings and expanding the consumption scenarios. We also increased traffic allocation and subsidies for branded products to capture and serve high-value users effectively.

In the third quarter of 2026, on the supply side, we remained committed to onboarding new merchants, strengthening our systematic capabilities in brand merchant acquisition, and expanding merchant support initiatives to scale their businesses and improve merchant retention. In the third quarter of 2026, both the new merchant retention rate and the scaled growth rate of existing merchants improved steadily quarter-over-quarter. In the third quarter of 2026, for brand merchants, we continued to optimize the coordination between traffic strategies and supply structure to enhance brand operations and growth. On the brand supply front, brand matrix accounts expanded rapidly, with the number of newly opened brand stores increasing by more than 50.0% year-over-year. On the traffic front, we leveraged broader interest-based recommendations, targeted reach to high-value users and optimized omni-domain recommendation pathways to help brands engage high-value users more effectively on our platform. Together, improvements in brand supply and traffic strategies drove greater exposure for branded products and more effective conversion of high-value users. This, in turn, drove growth in both MAC and GMV among high-value users for brand merchants. Meanwhile, in the fourth quarter of last year, we launched T2000 Initiative, a dedicated program for top-tier brands, under which we implemented more granular, tiered operations tailored to the varying operational capabilities of participating brands. We also launched brand-week campaigns to boost in brands' self-operated live streaming activity, building stronger and more consistent brand awareness among users.

In the third quarter of 2026, in e-commerce content development and KOL operations, we focused on follower growth and live streaming frequency among human KOLs, continuously optimizing the KOL ecosystem and prioritizing the quality of content supply. During the third quarter of 2026, we optimized our traffic strategies and implemented targeted governance initiatives. Under our traffic distribution mechanism, we directed more traffic towards high-quality creators, thereby fostering healthier content fundamentals for e-commerce. We also continued to deepen our partnerships with top-tier KOLs. Through initiatives such as VIP services for top-tier KOLs and collaborative content development for major live streaming events, we maintained a stable supply of livestreams from our core KOLs. We also increased incentives for core KOLs, thereby driving a notable quarter-over-quarter increase in their streaming frequency in the third quarter of 2026. In addition, we continued to collaborate with external service providers to diversify the pool of e-commerce content creators and enrich the supply of our e-commerce content.

We continued to leverage AI tools across the e-commerce operational workflow to help merchants improve operational efficiency. During the third quarter of 2026, we launched a fully managed AI operations solution tailored to small and medium-sized e-commerce merchants. By integrating our end-to-end AI tools, the solution enables one-stop content creation and distribution, with intelligent support adapted to different consumption scenarios to help small and medium-sized e-commerce merchants improve their operational performance. The solution delivered initial business gains during the third quarter of 2026.

Live streaming

In the third quarter of 2026, live streaming revenue was RMB7.8 billion, representing a decrease of 19.0% year-over-year. We focused on strengthening refined operations on the supply side, fostering deeper relationships between streamers and users, and leveraging AI to drive innovation across content and user interaction, while remaining firmly committed to the long-term and healthy development of the live streaming ecosystem. On the supply side, we continued to advance the Confluence Initiative (百川計划). Through acquisition incentives and operational support, we facilitated the recruitment and nurturing of talent agencies, reinforcing the fundamentals of our content supply. For independent streamers, we refined operations to enhance streamer services, and boost the activity of top-tier independent streamers. In terms of content ecosystem, we launched Kuaishou's first music-themed social reality show featuring streamers, Singing in the Mountains (向山而唱). The show brought together top-tier Kuaishou-native streamers and celebrities for musical performances in outdoor mountain settings, exploring a new variety show format centered on streamers. By the finale, the live streams garnered 270 million views.

In the third quarter of 2026, we advanced the cultivation of streamer-user relationships by taking a coordinated approach across content supply, product and traffic. We encouraged streamers to foster long-term user engagement. Through innovative features such as Fan Farm (粉絲農場), we drove conversion to paying users. We also refined our recommendation strategies to strengthen long-term matching between streamers and users, supporting the sustainable development of our live streaming ecosystem. On the product and technology front, we upgraded AI Universe (AI萬象) and launched AI-generated interactive features, bringing lightweight, variety-show-style interactive games into live streaming scenarios. These features offered users enjoyable and engaging interactive experiences, effectively expanding the range of interactions between viewers and streamers.

Overseas

In the third quarter of 2026, we continued to deepen our high-value user operations and strengthen localized ecosystems, balancing growth quality and profitability across our overseas business to lay a solid foundation for sustainable growth. In terms of traffic growth and the content ecosystem, we further improved user acquisition efficiency and our user growth structure. Centered on the needs of core users, we enriched locally relevant content, deepened content consumption and community engagement, and reinforced our high-value user base. For overseas online marketing services, we strengthened our AI-driven marketing product capabilities, exploring AI-assisted creation and localization of marketing materials. Through refined traffic operations and optimized placement strategies, we improved marketing placement efficiency and performance consistency. We remained focused on unlocking the monetization potential of short plays and other creative content formats, fostering synergies between our content ecosystem and monetization capabilities. Regarding overseas e-commerce, we maintained solid year-over- year growth in GMV and order volume in the third quarter of 2026. We leveraged our short video KOL ecosystem to drive transaction growth, optimizing merchant and product mix to meet local consumer demand better. High-quality supply also supported growth in average order value. While steadily scaling our overseas e-commerce business, we maintained operating efficiency and profitability.

Business Outlook

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter of 2026, the near-term operating environment remains challenging, with relatively conservative consumers' and marketers' spending sentiments and intense competition. In addition, we have experienced softness in our traffic trajectory, which will put further pressure on our monetization capabilities. Our ongoing strategic investments in Kling AI and our broader AI strategy will continue to carry cost implications and weigh on profitability in the near term. Therefore, our revenue and profitability may continue to be under pressure in the fourth quarter of 2026.

To cope with the challenges above, we are committed to a more disciplined approach to cost control and efficiency improvement in our core businesses. With confidence in our business model and long-term prospects, we will continue to return value to the Shareholders with our capital return initiatives in place. We believe that our financial discipline and strengthened AI capabilities will position us well to capture long-term growth opportunities and deliver sustainable values to the Shareholders.

data.title: Euro zone bond yields hold steady as energy prices remain subdued
data.description:
Euro zone bond yields were little changed on Thursday as energy prices held steady, with investors looking towards comments from European Central Bank officials later in the day for clues on interest rates.

Germany's 10-year bond yield (DE10YT=RR) fell less than 1 basis point (bp) to 3.372%.

It has fallen in recent months from a 17-year high of 3.653% touched in late September as energy prices have cooled, although it remains up around 50 bps for the year. Yields move inversely to prices.

Oil prices held steady on Thursday, with Brent crude at $92 a barrel, as US President Donald Trump met with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China. The conflicts in Ukraine and Iran are likely to be discussed, as is international trade.

President Christine Lagarde is among the European Central Bank officials set to speak later in the day as traders look for clues on interest rates.

Germany's 2-year bond yield (DE2YT=RR) was little changed at 3.127%.

The spread between French and German 10-year bond yields - which has risen sharply this year - was also roughly flat at 149 bps (DE10FR10=RR).

The Federal Reserve minutes released on Wednesday showed US policymakers saw a growing risk that they might need to step up their efforts to control inflation.

The focus of global financial markets was on the IPO of Anthropic , which has raised $81 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record, valuing the Claude chatbot maker at $1.5 trillion.

data.title: Dollar eases after seven-session rally, rates and equities in focus
data.description:
Key points:
  • Dollar edges down but still near highest since April 2, 2025
  • Yen falls against dollar, euro after safe-haven rally
  • Hawkish Fed signals keep further rate hikes on investors' radar

By Stefano Rebaudo

The US dollar index edged down on Thursday after a seven-session winning streak but remained underpinned by hawkish remarks from a Federal Reserve official that reinforced the case for further rate hikes.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for a more aggressive response to inflation, while minutes of the central bank's October 27 to 28 meeting showed policymakers increasingly concerned that additional tightening might be needed.

The dollar rally started on November 10 when hotter-than-expected US inflation data bolstered expectations that the Fed would raise borrowing costs next month.

The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when US President Donald Trump revealed a sweeping tariff package, triggering a selloff in US assets.

It was last down 0.05% at 103.73 , after reaching 103.97.

Barclays analysts said fiscal stimulus and strong AI-related capital spending point to a resilient US economy, a wider output gap and higher-for-longer interest rates, all supportive of dollar strength.

The dollar's gains have come despite a selloff in technology shares.

"First, the market has also repriced a more hawkish Fed given recent commentary pushing the interest rate differential wider, but the dollar seems to be overshooting this move," said George Saravelos, global head of forex strategy at Deutsche Bank, explaining the recent rise.

"Second, and more intriguingly, foreigners have been very aggressive buyers of US equities even as the stock market has tumbled," he added.

A Deutsche Bank tracker following more than 100 foreign-domiciled exchange-traded funds showed large dip-buying of US stocks by foreigners over the last two weeks, the biggest buying spree so far this year.

Such a move reinforces the view that the dollar has been supported by investor flows into US equities.

Shares in Nvidia fell overnight even after the chip bellwether beat revenue and guidance forecasts, amid uncertainty caused by co-founder Jensen Huang's sudden departure as CEO last week following his admission of extramarital affairs.

SAFE-HAVEN FLOWS BOOST THE YEN

The dollar was up 0.25% to 159.75 yen , snapping a four-day losing streak.

Analysts said that a further selloff in AI-linked assets could support the yen through safe-haven buying and repatriation flows, with the impact likely to be more pronounced against other currencies than against the dollar.

According to Barclays estimates, a 10% decline in the S&P 500 from its peak could push dollar/yen towards 155, while a 20% decline could pressure it towards 152.

The euro was up 0.34% versus the Japanese currency at 175.43, after falling about 1.5% since late last week.

The Aussie dropped as low as $0.6662 for the first time since January. Australia's employment fell for a second straight month in October and the jobless rate climbed to a five-year high, bolstering the view that rates have likely peaked.

Following the data, UBS economist George Tharenou brought forward his forecast for the first Reserve Bank of Australia rate cut to August next year from November, and extended the easing cycle to three cuts from two, citing elevated inflation and a deterioration in the labour and housing markets.

data.title: Malaysia's 2026 Inflation Likely to Be Lower Than Expected — Market Talk
data.description: Kenanga Investment Bank revises its Malaysia's 2026 inflation estimate lower to 1.8% from 1.9%, as lower crude oil prices are expected to help contain price pressures. It retains its 2027 inflation forecast at 2.0%, but sees upside risks from mid-year as higher household assistance payouts, higher minimum wages from June and El Nino-related food price pressures feed through. The expiry of electricity bill protections after December could add to inflation, Kenanga economists say in a note. Kenanga maintains its forecast for Bank Negara Malaysia to raise the policy rate by 25 bps to 3.00% in 1Q 2027, viewing this as policy normalization rather than the start of a tightening cycle. data.title: French Green leader ready to back hard-left Melenchon's bid for presidency
data.description:
French Green leader and presidential candidate Marine Tondelier, who is lagging in opinion polls, has opened the door to backing the candidacy of hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon, potentially damaging centre-left leader Raphael Glucksmann's efforts to galvanise the left.

  • "The momentum behind Jean-Luc Melenchon's campaign is undeniable. So let me be very clear: I am ready, and the Greens are ready, to work toward a coalition centered on Jean-Luc Melenchon's candidacy," Tondelier told France 2 television late on Wednesday

  • "If France Unbowed (LFI) is willing to begin building a coalition and work towards a presidential majority in which everyone can find a place, then there is a possible path forward," she added

  • Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin said this week Melenchon could win the second round of the 2027 presidential election if he faces far-right leader Marine Le Pen, although opinion polls have so far consistently shown Le Pen winning such a runoff

  • Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot called Tondelier's move a "capitulation," adding on X: "By stepping aside in favour of Jean-Luc Melenchon, Marine Tondelier is bringing to an end 50 years of French political environmentalism that had made Europe and democracy its guiding principles"

  • Opinion polls show Tondelier winning the support of only 2% to 4% of first-round votes, and not all of her supporters are expected to back Melenchon

  • The first round of the presidential election is set for April 18 next year, with a second-round runoff likely in May

data.title: Swedish central bank expects gradual normalisation of rates, governor says
data.description:
Sweden's central bank envisages "a gradual normalisation" of the policy interest rate going forward, Governor Erik Thedeen told a parliamentary hearing on Thursday.

The Riksbank this month raised its policy rate for the first time since 2023, pointing to inflation risks from the Middle East conflict and a stronger economy, and meeting minutes showed another hike is likely in the coming months.

"To ensure low and stable inflation in a stronger economic climate, we raised the policy rate to 2%. But it's more about easing off the accelerator for the Swedish economy than putting the brakes on it," Thedeen said on Thursday in the written summary of a speech.

"We envisage a gradual normalisation of the policy rate going forward," he added.
